extremal_perturbation: run extremal perturbation on a PyTorch model to compute saliency masks for a target activation channel
Perturbation: create a perturbation pyramid from an input tensor using blur or fade perturbation types
MaskGenerator: build a smooth mask generator that produces saliency masks from parameter tensors with configurable step and sigma
simple_reward: compute a simple reward tensor from model activations for preserve, delete, or dual variants
contrastive_reward: compute a contrastive reward tensor that subtracts the max non-target activation from the target activation
